title: Coverage
description: Capture loss by cause, observed and not-observed tool, API and gateway combinations, unmapped PR authors, and the documented blind spots (FR-030).

list.name: gateway
list.label: Gateway
list.query: SELECT gateway_type FROM v_capture_daily UNION SELECT gateway_type FROM v_coverage_daily ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT gateway_type FROM v_capture_daily UNION SELECT gateway_type FROM v_coverage_daily ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(responses), 0) FROM v_capture_daily WHERE gateway_type IN (${gateway:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(day)

panels.title: Responses lost

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(lost), 0) FROM v_coverage_daily WHERE gateway_type IN (${gateway:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(day) AND cause NOT IN ('seq_gap', 'heartbeat_missed')

panels.description: Responses the gateway served that capture couldn't fingerprint, by any self-reported cause. None of them count as human.

panels.title: Capture not reporting

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(seconds), 0) FROM v_coverage_daily WHERE gateway_type IN (${gateway:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(day) AND cause = 'heartbeat_missed'

panels.description: Time a capture instance (or all of them) stopped sending heartbeats. The gateway fails open, so responses in these periods weren't captured; PRs whose matching window overlaps are marked incomplete.

panels.title: Not observed lines
panels.description: Lines in PRs credited to GitHub accounts without a gateway credential. The portal's /coverage page lists the accounts (admins).

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS time, cause AS metric, sum(lost) AS value FROM v_coverage_daily WHERE gateway_type IN (${gateway:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(day) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT day AS time, unmapped_accounts AS "Accounts" FROM v_unmapped_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY 1

SELECT gateway_type AS "Gateway", api_format AS "API format", tool AS "Tool", sum(responses) AS "Responses", sum(captured) AS "Fully captured", sum(partial) AS "Partly captured", sum(unknown_credential) AS "Unknown credential", string_agg(DISTINCT alg::text, ', ') AS "Algorithm" FROM v_capture_daily WHERE gateway_type IN (${gateway:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(day) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: Not-observed combinations

targets.rawSql: SELECT gateway_type AS "Gateway", api_format AS "API format", tool AS "Tool", sum(lost) AS "Responses" FROM v_coverage_daily WHERE gateway_type IN (${gateway:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(day) AND cause = 'unsupported_combination' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.description: Model responses through the gateway on a route, API format or tool capture can't read (FR-007).

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "Day", gateway_type AS "Gateway", cause AS "Cause", api_format AS "API format", tool AS "Tool", lost AS "Count", periods AS "Periods", ongoing AS "Ongoing", round(seconds) AS "Seconds" FROM v_coverage_daily WHERE gateway_type IN (${gateway:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day DESC, lost DESC

panels.title: What the gateway can never observe

options.content:
Attribution only sees model output that passes through the gateway. Code from anything else lands as **human**
("no match to observed AI output"), or as **not observed** when its author has no gateway credential. These are
known blind spots, not errors (FR-040, FR-041).

## Out of scope for v1

- **GitHub Copilot**: inline completions and next-edit suggestions go to GitHub's service, not through a
  configurable endpoint. Copilot Chat in some editors allows custom endpoints, but it isn't validated here.
- **Cursor**: Tab completions, Composer and inline edit use Cursor's own backend.

## Never observable

- Chat output copied from a browser tab or another app and pasted into the editor.
- Any coding tool, plug-in or agent that isn't pointed at the gateway, or that a developer runs with their own
  provider key.
- Model output produced before the developer got a gateway credential, or older than the matching window
  (14 days by default).

## Partly observable

- Formatter rewrites of AI code: lines that change shape can drop from *AI, unmodified* to *AI, modified* or
  *human* (the release bar tracks this; see SC-003).
- Responses the gateway let through while capture was down. They're recorded as capture loss and show as
  *incomplete coverage* on affected changes (US4).
